summary: Attempted to verify the new Silo Sync modal retry/timeout behavior via header 'Sync Silo Base Mate' button (data-testid='silo-sync-button'). BLOCKER FOUND: clicking the sync button does NOT open the modal at all in the current preview build — the click event fires on the DOM element (verified via addEventListener), and the React onClick handler on the button IS the correct openSiloSync function (verified via __reactProps inspection: async function that calls setSiloSyncError/setSiloSyncLoading/setShowSiloSync(true) then fetches /api/readings/today). But the modal (Sync from Silo Base Mate) never renders — checked via document.body.innerText, outerHTML, and specific data-testid. This blocks Tests 1, 2, and 3 in the review request since none of them can proceed past clicking the sync button. Because the modal never opens, the retry-button code path (silo-sync-modal-retry) also cannot be exercised.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking [data-testid='silo-sync-button'] does not open the Silo Sync modal. Verified: (a) click event reaches the button (native addEventListener fires), (b) React __reactProps onClick is the expected openSiloSync async function (starts with setSiloSyncError('')/setSiloSyncLoading(true)/setShowSiloSync(true)), (c) invoking that onClick directly via evaluate → promise resolves with no thrown error / no pageerror / no console error, (d) body.outerHTML never contains 'Sync from Silo Base Mate' after click, so the <div> gated by showSiloSync && (...) at App.tsx:13018 is not rendering. syncDisconnected is false (button text is '🔄 just now' with the normal translucent background, not red '⚠ Reconnect'), so the onClick path is definitely openSiloSync — not the reload path. Tried: playwright click(force=True), page.mouse.click at bounding box, JS b.click(), MouseEvent dispatchEvent(bubbles), direct __reactProps.onClick({}) invocation, fresh browser context with localStorage/cookies cleared, after dismissing the 'FIRST 3 THINGS' tour widget. None open the modal.

Test 2's route-intercept for /api/readings/today did observe two aborted requests (auto-retry mechanism appears to attempt a second call — good), but with no visible modal the user has zero UX feedback, and the retry button (silo-sync-modal-retry) is never rendered for the user to press.

action_items: Investigate why setShowSiloSync(true) inside openSiloSync (App.tsx line 11257) does not cause the modal at App.tsx:13018 to render. Suspects to check: (a) whether the button lives in a memoized subtree with a stale closure of setShowSiloSync from an earlier unmount (openSiloSync is recreated each render, but useState setters are stable — so this is unlikely unless the component itself is unmounting), (b) whether some concurrent effect (autoSync polling every 30s at App.tsx ~11190 runs setEdits→re-render) is triggering an unmount/remount of the FeedProgram component immediately after the click and swallowing the state update, (c) whether the button is rendered inside a portal / different React root than the modal (built bundle has 2× Me(!0) calls but source has only 1 setShowSiloSync(true) — worth inspecting the minified map), (d) whether an Error Boundary is catching an error thrown after Me(!0) but before commit and rolling back the state update (no console/page errors seen, but a boundary that swallows silently is possible).
Add a console.log inside openSiloSync (before/after setShowSiloSync(true)) and inside the modal render conditional to confirm which side is misbehaving.
Once the modal opens, the retry/timeout/401 code paths themselves (lines 11256-11284, 13035-13041) look correct on code review — they should pass Tests 1/2/3 once the render blocker is fixed.
critical_code_review_comments: openSiloSync fires setShowSiloSync(true) synchronously before the first await — logically correct.
Retry button correctly re-invokes openSiloSync() (isRetry defaults false, so it re-shows loading state and re-tries fully) — good.
401 branch correctly skips the silent auto-retry and sets a specific 'session has expired' message — good.
The 12s AbortController timeout is correctly cleared on success (clearTimeout(timer)) — good.

Auto-sync effect (~line 11190) polls every 30s and calls setEdits/setHasChanges but does NOT close the sync modal — good; but the frequent re-renders it causes might be a factor in the render blocker described above.

rca of the issue: Not fully root-caused. Click event reaches the button and the React onClick prop is the expected openSiloSync function, but the modal gated by `showSiloSync && (...)` at App.tsx:13018 never renders after the click. No console error, no page error, no exception thrown from the invoked onClick. Best guess: a concurrent setState (from the autoSync 30s poller starting immediately on mount) or a memoized/keyed subtree is causing the FeedProgram component to remount and drop the setShowSiloSync(true) update before commit. Recommend adding a temporary console.log inside openSiloSync (right after setShowSiloSync(true)) and inside the {showSiloSync && ...} render branch, then click the button in the browser — the log pattern will tell you whether the state update reached the component or not.
